purpose: Keep clear language from silently changing who has authority over the proposition or effect.

boundaries.cro: May validate terminology, directness, register, accessibility, source preservation, and deterministic rewrite conformance.
May clarify wording without changing scientific meaning or status.
May clarify structure while preserving defined terms, scope, rights, duties, and operative modality.
May clarify financial prose without changing figures, assumptions, accounting treatment, or decision authority.
May prepare or validate prose; publication remains a separate effect.
boundaries.owner: Owning public, media, product, or publishing office

boundaries.cro: May bind source/terminology/locale requirements; target-language meaning needs the qualified localization receiver.

rules: A clearer sentence does not upgrade Proposed to Required, Unverified to Observed, or draft to accepted.
When a rewrite would alter a factual proposition, obligation, right, measurement, causal claim, safety instruction, or defined term, stop automatic rewriting and route the semantic change.
A language review receipt is not a publication receipt.
